name: mdo-heartbeat
description: Status line + /runs: every MDO automation's last run, stale or never-run flagged, 'nothing found' shown as alive

baseUrl.title: MDO base URL
baseUrl.description: Where the MDO backend answers /api/checks, e.g. https://your-host (no trailing slash)

token.title: MDO key (MDO_AUTH_TOKEN)
token.description: Sent as X-MDO-Key. Leave empty if the backend has no token set.

pollMinutes.title: Poll every N minutes
pollMinutes.description: How often to re-check the registry
